CompanyEvidenceInput.title: Company Evidence Graph Input
CompanyEvidenceInput.description: Input schema for company_evidence_graph.v1 service. At least one identity signal is required.

requested_field_groups.description: Field groups to include in the result.

buyer_urls.description: Buyer-provided public URLs for supplemental evidence.

freshness_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable age of data in seconds.

jurisdiction_hints.description: Optional jurisdiction hints for regulatory context.

CompanyEvidenceOutput.title: Company Evidence Graph Output
CompanyEvidenceOutput.description: Output schema for company_evidence_graph.v1 service. Must be a valid PCC 1.0.0 document with required net.siteborne.company-evidence.v1 extension.

field_groups.description: Requested field groups with completion state.

normalized_facts.description: Normalized XBRL facts keyed by concept.

claim.description: The claim that was verified absent.

WebContextInput.title: Verified Web Context Input
WebContextInput.description: Input schema for web_context_verified.v1 service. Supports direct and rendered retrieval modes.

target_url.description: Target URL to retrieve. Public HTTP/HTTPS only.

buyer_schema.description: Optional buyer-provided JSON Schema for structured output validation.

field_selectors.description: Requested field selectors for structured output.

freshness_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable age of cached content in seconds.

max_content_size.description: Maximum content size in bytes to return.

max_redirects.description: Maximum number of redirects to follow.

WebContextOutput.title: Verified Web Context Output
WebContextOutput.description: Output schema for web_context_verified.v1 service. Must be a valid PCC 1.0.0 document with required net.siteborne.web-context.v1 extension.

retrieval_mode_used.description: Mode actually used (may differ if rendered unavailable).

DocumentEvidenceInput.title: Document Evidence JSON Input
DocumentEvidenceInput.description: Input schema for document_evidence_json.v1 service. Exactly one document reference mode required.

ocr_permission.description: Whether OCR is permitted for image-based content.

DocumentEvidenceOutput.title: Document Evidence JSON Output
DocumentEvidenceOutput.description: Output schema for document_evidence_json.v1 service. Must be a valid PCC 1.0.0 document with required net.siteborne.document-evidence.v1 extension.

AgentVerificationInput.title: Agent Output Verification Input
AgentVerificationInput.description: Input schema for verify_agent_output.v1 service. Supports standard and independent reproduction modes.

candidate_output.description: The agent output to verify. Cannot modify verifier policy.

supplied_evidence.description: Evidence items supplied with the candidate output.

required_schema.description: Required output schema (JSON Schema) that candidate must conform to.

AgentVerificationOutput.title: Agent Output Verification Output
AgentVerificationOutput.description: Output schema for verify_agent_output.v1 service. Must be a valid PCC 1.0.0 document with required net.siteborne.agent-verification.v1 extension.
